submission.justification: R3 at 3 cm gives the highest simulated pi/K separation at 10 GeV/c, 4.67 sigma. The scan over 1-6 cm peaks at 3 cm; 2.5 cm gives 4.38 and 3.5 cm gives 4.5. R1 peaks at 3.947 sigma and R2 at 2.717 sigma. The 2025 reference values rank the options the same way (R3 4.6, R1 3.8, R2 2.9). Caveat: no degradation figures were found for any candidate (degradation_figures_found = 0), so the lifetime-performance constraint is unverified for R3 and for the others. R3 should be checked against the radiation and aging data before it is committed. If R3 fails that check, the fallback is R1 at 3 cm (3.947 sigma).
